tasks.description: Identify potential payment providers that can be integrated with our application. Consider factors such as security, fees, and ease of integration. Finalize the selection of a payment provider after discussing with the finance and legal teams.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of potential payment providers, when the research is complete, then a recommendation for a payment provider is made.

tasks.description: Work with the finance team to determine the plan tiers and their corresponding prices. Consider factors such as revenue goals, competition, and customer demand.
acceptance_criteria: Given a set of plan tiers and prices, when the finance team has approved them, then the plan tiers and prices are finalized.

tasks.description: Integrate the selected payment provider with our application. This includes handling payment processing, errors, and security.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user who attempts to make a payment, when the payment is processed successfully, then the payment is recorded in the user's account.

tasks.description: Create the subscription plans in the application, including the plan tiers and prices determined earlier.
acceptance_criteria: Given a set of plan tiers and prices, when the plans are created, then the plans are visible in the application.

tasks.description: Activate the user's subscription plan after a successful payment. This includes updating the user's account status and granting access to the paid features.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user who has made a payment, when the subscription is activated, then the user has access to the paid features.

tasks.summary: Add payment method to user account
tasks.description: Allow users to add a payment method to their account, such as a credit card or PayPal account.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user who attempts to add a payment method, when the payment method is added successfully, then the payment method is visible in the user's account.

tasks.description: Implement tax calculation and refund handling for payments. This includes integrating with the payment provider's tax and refund APIs.
acceptance_criteria: Given a payment that includes tax, when the tax is calculated correctly, then the tax amount is displayed to the user. Given a user who requests a refund, when the refund is processed successfully, then the refund is recorded in the user's account.

tasks.description: Test the entire payment flow, including payment processing, subscription activation, and tax and refund handling.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user who attempts to make a payment, when the payment is processed successfully, then the payment is recorded in the user's account and the subscription is activated.
